name: Pusztafalu (Hungary)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pusztafalu: a crowned red and blue shield with white bars and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a sabre crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, supported by two stags, above a scroll inscribed PUSZTAFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pusztafalu arms with crown, helm, crest, supporters and scroll
